# Routing Rules — TDD Squad

**Default agent:** @red

## Rules

- `write-tests` → @red — Test cases, test suites, failing tests, test-first, specs
- `implement` → @green — Make tests pass, implement, minimum code, fix tests
- `refactor` → @blue — Clean up, code quality, extract method, rename, simplify
- `tdd-cycle` → @red, @green, @blue — Full TDD cycle: Red → Gate → Green → Blue
- `tdd-pipeline` → @red, @green, @blue — Parallel TDD pipeline: Red tests Feature N+1 while Green implements Feature N and Blue refactors Feature N-1 — only when features produce SEPARATE files
